failures.question: For each month from February 2011 to November 2011, what was the percentage change in revenue versus the previous month?
failures.example_sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.month,
        d.month_name,
        d.month_start,
        SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE s.invoice_date >= '2011-02-01' AND s.invoice_date < '2011-12-01'
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_name, d.month_start
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        month,
        month_name,
        month_start,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
    revenue,
    prev_revenue,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(CAST(((revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2)
    END AS percentage_change
FROM with_lag
WHERE month_start >= '2011-02-01' AND month_start <= '2011-11-01'
ORDER BY year, month

failures.question: What was our net revenue in 2011 after cancellations?
failures.example_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.revenue), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(c.revenue), 0) AS net_revenue FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN fact_sales s ON s.date_key = d.date_key AND s.invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND s.invoice_date < '2012-01-01' LEFT JOIN fact_cancellations c ON c.date_key = d.date_key AND c.invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND c.invoice_date < '2012-01-01' WHERE d.year = 2011
